question: Should OpenClaw accept `openai/codex-action` v1.11 for the API-key-bearing Codex workflows after its Node-24 and permission-profile contract changes?
rationale: The patch is a compatible pin refresh, but these workflows invoke third-party code while handling an OpenAI API key, so the repository owner must make the trust-boundary acceptance decision.

options.title: Approve the reviewed action upgrade

options.title: Split out the Codex action update
